_doc: Map town sprites of the three v0.2 factions (the Realm, the Restless, the Goblin Horde) at the 3x2 footprint of art/sets/towns-3x2: requested at 232x176 and seated in a 240x184 canvas whose bottom 160 rows are the footprint. Two growth stages per faction, picked by the town's fort level: 'camp' (fort 0-1, a light wall) and 'fort' (fort 2-3, a stone or scrap wall with a gatehouse). The Horde's fort stage reuses the accepted Warlord's Hold (towns-3x2/goblin-hold-v4a#0). Gate in the middle of the front wall over the entry cell; yard transparent; no flags (the owner shows in the interface). Class contract: docs/art/classes/towns.md. Recipes are never edited after generation: add a new id (new seed) instead. Retired by bead bzc.97: its map towns were redrawn in set chunky-towns, so it derives no game files any more (masters and records stay as history).

lostWorldLayout.usage: copy the size, outline thickness, pixel size and the layout of a round walled town with its gate in the middle of the front wall; not the colours and not the materials

recipes.subject: Subject: a big cheerful storybook castle town that fills the whole image from the left edge to the right edge, seen from above at a three-quarter angle: a wide oval ring of crenellated curtain walls of pale cream limestone #e6d8b4 with #b3a07a shadows; the front wall runs across the bottom of the image facing the viewer, and in the exact middle of the front wall a big gatehouse with two round towers and a dark arched gate; four round towers on the ring with pointed conical roofs of tabard blue #2f6fd0 with #1f4a8f shadows; inside the walls a tall square keep at the back with a blue conical roof, a long timber-framed hall with a warm red-brown roof #a8492f and white plaster walls, and a small chapel. The yard is empty and transparent: nothing is drawn under the town. Buildings only.

recipes.subject: Subject: a big spooky-cute graveyard town from a comedy ghost story that fills the whole image from the left edge to the right edge, seen from above at a three-quarter angle: a wide oval ring of low walls of dark slate stone #5b5866 with #3a3842 shadows topped with black iron railings; the front wall runs across the bottom of the image facing the viewer, and in the exact middle of the front wall a big black iron gate between two stone pillars with glowing shroud violet #7a4fb5 lanterns; inside the walls a crooked gothic chapel with a tall pointed bell tower and steep shroud violet #7a4fb5 slate roofs with #4e2f7a shadows, a round domed mausoleum of pale bone stone #d8d0bc, a tall thin manor house, rows of leaning cream tombstones and one bare crooked dead tree. The yard is empty and transparent: nothing is drawn under the town. Buildings only.
